tools.name: search_agencies
tools.description: Search 960+ evidence-checked AI automation, internal-tools and AI-app agencies on Cofounderbase by a plain-English need. Optional filters: country, tool (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Vapi) and max starting budget in USD. Returns ranked agencies with a reason for each match and a profile link.

tools.name: get_agency
tools.description: Full Cofounderbase profile for one agency by slug (from search results): location, tools, use cases, industries, services, published prices, case studies, partner certifications and score.

tools.name: top_agencies
tools.description: Highest-scored agencies on Cofounderbase for a use case (e.g. "Voice agents", "Chatbots", "RAG/knowledge base", "CRM automation/sync"), a tool (e.g. "n8n") and/or a country.

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Ask Cofounderbase to introduce the user to up to 5 agencies. Only call this when the user explicitly asks for an introduction and gives their own name and email. A person reviews every request; the user gets one confirmation email.
